# regru_record_aaaa (Resource)

Manages an AAAA record for a domain.

The reg.ru API has no operation to update a record, so this provider handles changes to `zone`, `name`, or `ip` as a replacement. It sequentially deletes the existing record and then creates the new one.

If a matching AAAA record already exists, the reg.ru API treats the create request as a no-op and returns success. Therefore, importing the record into Terraform state is optional.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Point local.example.com to 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1
resource "regru_record_aaaa" "example" {
  zone = "example.com"
  name = "aaaa"
  ip   = "0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Target IPv6 address.
- `name` (String) Subdomain name, `*` for a wildcard, or `@` for the zone apex.
- `zone` (String) Name of the domain for this record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID format: zone,name,ip.
terraform import regru_record_aaaa.i example.com,local,0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1
```
